comment: External footprint repositories that klepcbgen pulls real KiCad footprints from. The generator shallow-clones each repo into ~/.klepcbgen/footprint-repos/ and uses the real .kicad_mod files instead of the built-in placeholder templates.

cherry_mx.comment: Single-stem MX stabilizer cutout; place one footprint per stem offset (plate's _stab_offsets) so it works for every key size. Stem offset (plate_stab_offset) applies from the physical switch center.

alps.comment: Matias/Alps use the same MX stabilizer footprint geometry.

choc.comment: Kailh Choc (PG1350) stabilizer cutout. Not yet verified for per-stem placement; choc stabs are rare.

mx.comment: Keebio MX through-hole switch footprints (KiCad 5 format, centered on origin, 0,0 = alignment hole). pad 1 = matrix A, pad 2 = diode. No 6.25u file exists, so wide keys fall back to 2.75u.

mx_alps.comment: Keebio MX/Alps hybrid through-hole. Only 1u, 1.25u, 2u-ReversedStabilizers available. pad 1 = matrix A, pad 2 = diode.

mx_hotswap.comment: Keebio MX hotswap SMD sockets. pad 1 = matrix A, pad 2 = diode.

mx_hotswap_antishear.comment: Keebio MX hotswap SMD sockets with anti-shear support. pad 1 = matrix A, pad 2 = diode.

mx_hotswap_outemu.comment: Keebio MX hotswap SMD sockets for Outemu switches (bottom-mounted pads on B.Cu). pad 1 = matrix A, pad 2 = diode.
